objective: Auditar en POS SoftRestaurant el inventario fisico mas reciente para ESTELAR, CIENFUEGOS y 130MID. Solo lectura.

queries.name: ultimo_inventario_softrestaurant
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 1 CAST(INV.folio AS VARCHAR(50)) AS folio, INV.fecha AS fecha, CAST(INV.idalmacen1 AS VARCHAR(50)) AS almacen_id, COALESCE(A.nombre,CAST(INV.idalmacen1 AS VARCHAR(50))) AS almacen FROM invfisico INV LEFT JOIN almacen A ON A.idalmacen=INV.idalmacen1 WHERE ISNULL(INV.cancelado,0)=0 ORDER BY INV.fecha DESC,INV.folio DESC
